text: It is highly likely that Russia’s October 2025 launch rate was moderately reduced due to worsening weather conditions It is almost certain that Russia aims to saturate targets including military industry and airfields to both maximise damage and increase the survivability of premier missiles Russia’s Long Range Aviation (LRA) bomber tempo also slowed in October 2025, likely linked to weather conditions and other priority tasking, specifically the culmination of Russia’s training/testing season
